integrity: The classification partitions the class into width-one objects, bounded by a Euclidean slab of thickness at most one, and a single exceptional lattice class. Its integer half-cofactor matrix has determinant two and an even column sum. Determinant and parity force an optimal column-norm lower bound of square root two; equality determines the entire Euclidean Gram matrix. An explicit unimodular representative attains the bound. An integer-arithmetic program independently checks the exact matrices and bounded normal configurations.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to full-dimensional lattice zonotopes in standard Euclidean three-space with Ehrhart h-star degree exactly two. Relies on the cited complete lattice-equivalence classification. Does not extend to all hollow lattice polytopes or to higher-dimensional zonotopes. Historical equivalence under other terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: A unique tangential rhombohedron maximizes the inradius of degree-two lattice zonotopes
